end.summary:
Practised 4-digit numbers up to 9999 with internal zeros and expanded place values.
Wrote 2004, 3075, and 4050 using thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones.
Read and wrote 8614 in numerals and words.
Identified the tens digit in 8614 and the hundreds digit in 352.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Diya practised building numbers from place values and checking each digit’s position. They correctly wrote numbers such as 3075 and 4050, and self-corrected the reading of “eight thousand six hundred fourteen” to 8614. There was a brief mix-up about the tens digit in 8614, which was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Diya to say a 4-digit number in words and then write its thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones digits.
